messages.content: We are a dental clinic in Bengaluru

For a **dental clinic in bengaluru**, here is how BIZORA can help you grow online:

• **Interactive Online Catalogue / Website:** Showcase your product models, brands, and specifications so local buyers find you on Google Search.
• **Instant WhatsApp Inquiries:** Customers can tap one button to ask about prices or stock directly on your WhatsApp.
• **Location & Directions:** Embedded Google Maps so walk-in customers find your shop easily.

Would you like customers to also request delivery or quotations through the website?

Regarding **Appointment & Enquiry Management Portals**:

- Description: Online appointment booking systems designed to eliminate missed phone calls and receptionist bottleneck during peak business hours.
- Key Capabilities: 24/7 patient/client slot selection, doctor/consultant calendar availability, automated WhatsApp & SMS confirmation alerts, internal staff dashboard to view, reschedule, or manage customer appointments.
- Inclusions: Doctor/staff schedule management, cancellation policies, patient intake details, exportable appointment history.
- Ideal For: Healthcare clinics, dental practices, physiotherapy centers, wellness salons, diagnostic labs, and consulting firms.
- Delivery Timeline: 10 to 18 business days.

Would you like more details on this, or shall we arrange a free discovery call with our team?
